productUrls.title: Direct Alibaba Product URLs
productUrls.description: List of direct product detail URLs from alibaba.com (if provided, scrapes these product pages directly).

searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords
searchKeywords.description: Keywords to search on Alibaba for wholesale products and factories (e.g. 'bamboo cutting board', 'wireless earbuds').

verifiedSupplierOnly.title: Verified Suppliers Only
verifiedSupplierOnly.description: Filter search results to show only inspected and Verified Suppliers.

tradeAssuranceOnly.title: Trade Assurance Only
tradeAssuranceOnly.description: Filter search results to show only products covered by Alibaba Trade Assurance.

maxProducts.title: Max Products Per Search
maxProducts.description: Maximum number of product records to extract per keyword.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Residential or Datacenter Proxy to bypass Alibaba anti-scraping protections.
